entries.title: Frisian / Farisan: Declarative Security Policy Architecture in Programming Languages
entries.summary: Investigates embedding API security constraints, capability boundaries, and static policy verification directly into programming language grammar and AST analysis.

entries.title: Context Grounding & Chunking Strategies in Local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
entries.summary: Explores document chunking granularity, vector retrieval top-k thresholds, and prompt framing techniques to minimize hallucinations in local RAG pipelines.

entries.title: REST API Security Contracts and Schema Validation Patterns in FastAPI Microservices
entries.summary: Documents structural patterns for input sanitization, strict Pydantic schema validation, and defensive API design for AI-backed web services.

entries.title: System Architecture for Voice-First & Multimodal AI Assistants on Android
entries.summary: Architectural study on low-latency command routing, state transitions, and backend orchestration for native Android AI assistants (ARCHON & Project Universal).
